reason: I buy in quantity for the shop, and 13,000 a kilo by air plus 8% kills my margin on accessories and parts. My agent already ships my 1688 orders by cargo for less per kilo, so I'm used to him and he's cheaper.
objection: On a bulk order the per-piece landed cost is too high with air at 13,000 per kilo, and I don't know if a new service will hit its delivery dates when my customers are waiting.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper bulk rate for big 1688 orders, like slower cargo shipping well under 13,000 a kilo and a lower buying fee on large orders, with a guaranteed delivery date.
